items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: There was Bo Moose Johnson or something like that. Jackson. Jackson. And there was Ella Fitzgerald. I played about five or six different bands, you know, short of trombone player.

ctx.x: Then you became, even when you played with all those bigger band reading matches, you still play ad-libs?

Yeah well I'm not bragging but this is the category I was in. Whenever a band came to Rega Theater short of a trombone player, they used to look at me. There was Bo Moose Johnson or something like that. Jackson. Jackson. And there was Ella Fitzgerald. I played about five or six different bands, you know, short of trombone player. And they sent for me. And there wasn't a rehearsal, you understand? Jimmy Newman sent for me. They put the music on. I was able to play it, you understand what I'm talking about? Okay.…

Well anyway, when we started talking about the first band you played with, you know, with Bernie Young and this guy. Buddy Young. Yeah and you played, you said it was mostly Ad-lib. Yeah Ad-lib. Now I want to ask you from the beginning one of the questions I want to ask. How old were you when you came to Chicago?
